services.desc: Our second Escape Room: Escape Room Strongsville opened in June 2017, located in the Strongsville Towne Center Plaza, around the corner from the SouthPark Mall. This location is within minutes of local fine dining opportunities such as Don’s Pomeroy House, making date nights, birthday parties, family fun nights and social gatherings a no brainer. Fort Knox has never been breached, most secure gold in the world. Until now, your team has an insider. A guard who has planted clues and tools to help. Can you reach the vault in time, the lockdown has began. You have 60 minutes, get the gold and get out. 700 billion in gold bars. Only one Chance! Every second counts! One insider, one chance, 700

blurb: Guests participate in escape rooms where they solve puzzles to escape within 60 minutes. Axe throwing sessions include safety training and practice before competing in group tournaments. Game Show Duels is a competitive game show experience for groups of 8 to 50 people with hosts and themed games.
